---
description: gap_check as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: checking what the story has said about something
arguments:
  topic: The thing to look for, by its name.
  terms: Its other names, and the words around it.
  limit: The most hits to give from each place.
---
Searches the chat, the lore and the other records the system offers for a topic, by its name, its other names and the words around it, and by meaning where that is set up. What was searched and what came back is saved with the turn as evidence, under the id the answer gives.
